description.value: Match Eatery & Public House is a chain pub-style restaurant and bar located on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, operated under the Gateway Casinos entertainment brand. The Langley outlet offers a full pub menu — burgers, pasta, pizza, wings, and daily specials — alongside a full bar and outdoor seating. It is one of roughly a dozen BC locations, making it a recognizable and consistent stop for travelers passing through the Fraser Valley corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for matchpub.com/langley loaded successfully and confirms the Langley location at 20393 Fraser Hwy with phone (604) 539-4424, which is absent from OSM tags. OSM confirms outdoor_seating=yes but no bike rack tags are present, and the website contains no mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or water refill. Takeout is confirmed by prominent 'Takeout & Delivery' and 'Pick Up' navigation elements on the Langley page.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number (604) 539-4424 sourced from website only.
Website footer lists a corporate/head-office address (100-4400 Dominion Street, Burnaby, BC V5G 4G3) distinct from the Langley location address — not a concern for the listing but noted for context.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, water refill, washrooms) mentioned anywhere on the website.
